tools.name: create_swap
tools.description:
Create the swap and get the deposit address. No funds move here: the user then sends amount_from of
from_asset to deposit_address (with deposit_extra_id as the memo, when present), as instructions says.
Follow it with get_swap.

tools.name: validate_address
tools.description:
Check a payout or refund address (create_swap runs the same check). valid: true; false: show reason to the
user and ask again; null: this network's format isn't checked here. extra_id_name: the asset uses a
memo/tag.

tools.name: list_currencies
tools.description:
Find assets and their networks. Each id ('ticker:network') works as from_asset or to_asset. contract: the
token's address; extra_id_name: the asset uses a memo/tag.

The exchanges compared, with what each asks of a swap (email_required, refund_address_required...), kyc,
